programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Who's Making Dinner?'. At a 50th anniversary event for Who's Making Dinner?, Deborah struggles with painful memories of her ex-husband and his history of downplaying her contributions to the show.

programme.title: Helderberg
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. A devastating premiere. In 1987, SAA Flight SA295 is reported overdue at Mauritius. The worst aviation disaster in South African history has taken place, and all answers to the mystery lie deep underwater.

programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Pilot'. A compelling premiere. After a call from her long-lost brother, Emma Le Roux returns home, where she and bodyguard Martin Dekker are drawn into a deadly world of poaching, corruption and secrets hidden in the Lowveld.

programme.title: Landman
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Sins Of The Father'. Angela and Ainsley cause chaos at the nursing home. Cami is blindsided by a lawsuit as Tommy warns Cooper about his shady entanglements.

programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. The investigation into the attack begins and news breaks about the bombers' identities and connections, fanning feelings of fear and discontent.

programme.title: Power Book 4: Force
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Do Or Die'. It's a new world with new threats in this premiere. With some of his biggest obstacles off the map, Tommy faces new opportunities and challenges in his quest to take over the Chicago drug game.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: 'S49/E3 - Cinema'. Reality and hunger take their toll as the castaways grapple with their limited resources. Generational differences appear as some castaways find it challenging to keep up with the younger players' lingo.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: 'S5/E13 - St. Hetty's Day 2: The Help'. A St. Patrick's Day staffing emergency gives Hetty the chance to step into an unlikely role at the restaurant as she regains her once-a-year ability to be seen and heard by the living.

programme.title: Ghosts
